props.title: RAF Fairford
props.caption: RAF Fairford, Gloucestershire. Every US bomber at the base flew to home stations on Sunday.
Geffray halted Monday lessons fully or partly at 400 to 500 high schools.
Southern Command directed a 4 October Caribbean strike that killed four.

items.note: Every US bomber at RAF Fairford flew to home stations on Sunday, including B-1s that had arrived within the week.
Geffray halted Monday lessons at 400 to 500 lycées after security conditions went unmet. Twenty-four schools were burned or ransacked.
Flávio Bolsonaro leads Lula 47.03% to 45.16% of valid votes, both short of 50%. Runoff is 25 October.
Dodik declared an SNSD sweep at the Friday rally in Banja Luka while Bosnia's election commission was still counting.

lead.what: Every US bomber at RAF Fairford flew to home stations on Sunday, including B-1s that had arrived within the week. At least 10 of 12 B-1s flew out.

rest.what: Flávio Bolsonaro leads Lula 47.03% to 45.16% of valid votes, both short of 50%. The count is essentially complete.

lead.what: Neither candidate reached 50%. Foreman puts Flávio as a 58% favorite; Tinkerton dissents at 0.48.

rest.what: Geffray halted Monday lessons fully or partly at 400 to 500 high schools after security conditions went unmet.

lead.what: Southern Command directed a 4 October Caribbean strike that killed four. It cited intelligence and offered no public drug evidence.

rest.what: Banned from office, Dodik declared an SNSD sweep while Bosnia's election commission was still counting. Turnout was 42%.
